# Emulator core

The files in `binjnes/` are from [binji/binjnes](https://github.com/binji/binjnes) at commit `e2f5871a28ff189daa82b70be9324a42e2aaf9fd`, under the included MIT license. The upstream renderer and frontend are not used. Maylang owns this app and the native UI; its Sokol backend owns the window and OpenGL rendering.

Local patches: cartridge lookup stops before reading past the final CRC-count entry; `emulator_delete` also frees `audio_buffer.data`, fixing the upstream allocation leak when switching cartridges; PPU shift/interleave operations use unsigned operands to avoid undefined signed shifts; iNES RAM capacity is checked, legacy zero RAM size defaults to 8 KiB, and the iNES PAL flag sets region timing.

`../demo.h` is our original Starfall homebrew, reproducibly generated by `../../roms/build_demo.py`. No commercial ROMs are bundled.
